intro.text: An honorspren living in Lasting Integrity.

items.text: Vaiu was one of Adolin's jailers during his trial, and with Alvettaren one of his main guards when he walked outside.

Escorting Adolin one day, Vaiu remarked on the crowd of deadeyes on the shore, which he thought drawn by some Connection to see justice done. He reminded Adolin that he had chosen this trial and told him to go study with the Blended for his defence.

appearance.text: Short, with a full square beard; he goes bare-chested in an old-style skirt like a takama and carries a winged spear.
